root_cause: Authorization creates a nested session while holding memory/preparation locks. With all pool connections held by lock waiters, the lock holder cannot check out another connection and times out. Increased video fanout exposed this existing pattern.
change: Reuse caller session through repository, reference authorizer, target and upload validation. Retain current owner/origin/target/document validation and worker/memory/budget fences. No pool-size increase.

regression.database: SQLite and private PostgreSQL cluster; no production DB

previous_restart_blocker: systemctl restart edu-ai-backend.service returned Interactive authentication required; neither production service was restarted after the pool fix.
